stances_toward.note: Constituent country of the Kingdom since its separate status (status aparte) on 1 Jan 1986; foreign relations and defence are Kingdom affairs under the Charter, and Dutch embassies represent all four countries. Local autonomy is wide (education, judiciary, health, tourism). Aruba lies close to the Venezuelan coast and shares with Curaçao a US Forward Operating Location for counter-drug flights; since January 2026 the Netherlands has halted joint counter-drug operations with the US and keeps its own units on notice. Own territory, but not one the Hague can dispose of alone (changes to the Charter need all four countries). Bond - kin.
